title: Matriarchal Myth
title_zh: 母系神话：女性艺术家影像群展
subtitle: A Group Exhibition of Women Artists Between Image and Myth
subtitle_zh: A Group Exhibition of Women Artists Between Image and Myth
artist: Grace Weston, Giorgia Lisi, Khaliyesa Barbara Minishi, Peiran Wang, Shuyan Liang, Tanja Krebs, Virginia Lupu, Yiming Zhu, Yuchen Li
summary: Nine women artists from different cultures treat myth as a living language, rewriting how bodies, identity and nature are imagined.
summary_zh: 九位来自不同文化背景的女性艺术家，把神话视为仍在生长的语言，重写身体、身份与自然被想象的方式。
about:
“Matriarchal Myth” starts from one idea: myth is not a fixed inheritance but a language that keeps being written. When women author it, the way bodies, identities and nature are imagined changes with it.

Working in photography and moving image, nine artists move between revisiting and remaking, subversion and continuity, showing myth as a way of thinking through which female subjectivity keeps taking shape.
about_zh:
“母系神话”从一个前提出发：神话不是静止的文化遗产，而是一种不断被书写的语言。当神话由女性讲述，身体、身份与自然被想象的方式也随之改变。

九位艺术家以摄影与影像为媒介，在重访与重塑、颠覆与延续之间展开创作，让神话成为一种思考方式，女性主体性由此不断生成。

title: Humanoid Illusion
medium_zh: 动作捕捉 · AI · 数字艺术
summary: Real dancers’ movements, turned into virtual figures through motion capture and AI, ask what it still means to be human.
summary_zh: 借助动作捕捉与AI，真实舞者的动作化身为虚拟形象，追问在数字时代“人”意味着什么。
about:
In an era when digital technology shapes what we see, how do we define a human presence? “Humanoid Illusion” turns real dancers’ movements into virtual figures through motion capture and AI, creating beings that live between human and machine, reality and illusion.

The closer technology comes to replicating us, the more uncertain our idea of humanity becomes. Facing these lifelike yet non-human figures, viewers are invited to rediscover what being human really means.
about_zh:
当数字技术塑造着视觉现实，我们该如何定义“人”的存在？《似人非人》借助动作捕捉与AI，把真实舞者的动作转化为虚拟形象，它们游走在人与机器、真实与幻象之间。

技术越接近完美复制人类，我们对“人”的理解就越模糊。面对这些栩栩如生却并非人类的形象，观众被邀请重新发现“成为人”的意义。

title: Autumn Snow
subtitle: The Blanket of Messaging Forms in Times of War
subtitle_zh: Autumn Snow: The Blanket of Messaging Forms in Times of War
summary: Leaflets falling like snow: a mixed-media installation on how information travels, and is remembered, in times of war.
summary_zh: 如雪花般飘落的传单：一组关于战争年代信息如何传播、又如何被记住的综合材料装置。
about:
In wartime, the way information travels shapes both the public and the conflict itself. Airdropped leaflets drift down like snowflakes, yet carry the opposite meaning: man-made objects falling from the sky signal misfortune.

Through mixed media, Beiyi Wang sets the snow globe, our wish to keep beauty forever, against leaflets that help redraw territorial maps, reflecting on memory, distance and hope for a better future.
about_zh:
战争年代，信息的传播方式既影响大众，也左右着交战各方。从空中飘落的传单像雪花一样美丽，意义却截然相反：从天而降的人造物，往往预示着不幸。

王贝伊以综合材料，将象征留住美好的雪花水晶球，与改写版图的传单并置，思考记忆、距离，以及对更好未来的期许。

title: MOVED
subtitle: The Aesthetic Beyond
summary: A furniture series by Hangzhou studio MOVED, where Eastern philosophy and natural materials reach “beyond the material.”
summary_zh: 杭州设计工作室 MOVED 动心的家具系列，以东方哲思与自然材料，探索“物外之境”。
about:
“Triggered and touched by a certain point, the moment of designing each piece is one of being moved.” In Eastern philosophy, form and realm are not opposites; they reflect each other.

Founded in Hangzhou in 2022, MOVED combines natural materials with Eastern philosophy. From wood grain to line, each piece is functional furniture and, more importantly, a dialogue through material and form.
about_zh:
“被某一刻触动，设计每一件作品的瞬间，都是心动的瞬间。”在东方哲学里，“形”与“境”并非对立，而是形神相映。

MOVED 动心 2022 年成立于杭州，将自然材料与东方哲思相结合。从木纹到线条，每件作品既是可以使用的家具，更是一场关于材料与形式的对话。

title: Sycamore & Lin Xinyu
summary: Small, intimate works hidden beneath the shade of sycamores, blurring the line between two and three dimensions.
summary_zh: 藏在梧桐树影下的小幅作品，模糊平面与立体之间的边界。
about:
Most works in “Sycamore & Lin Xinyu” sit beneath the shadows of trees, blurring the line between two and three dimensions and seeking a new balance between material and concept.

The sycamore is a theme the artist keeps returning to, drawing on sensory experience and personal memory to build timeless fragments of recollection. Born in Nanjing in 2001, she lives and works in Shanghai across video, performance, installation and painting.
about_zh:
《梧我》的大部分作品隐藏在树影之下，模糊二维与三维空间的边界，在物质与观念之间寻找新的平衡。

梧桐是艺术家反复回到的主题，她从感官经验与个人记忆出发，在时间的洪流中构筑永恒的记忆碎片。艺术家 2001 年生于南京，现工作生活于上海，创作涵盖影像、行为、装置与绘画。

title: Narrated: The Self as the Other
title_zh: 被叙述的：作为他者的自身
subtitle: The 2nd Shanghai Museum/Gallery Staff Biennale
subtitle_zh: 第二届上海美术馆/画廊职工双年展
artist: Xi Chen, Zekai Chen, Yingqiong Liu, Zhuosiqi Meng, Hongming Teng, Ying Xue, Juntao Yang, Yu Zhao
summary: The 2nd Shanghai Museum/Gallery Staff Biennale: eight artists trace a journey from selfhood to what we share.
summary_zh: 第二届上海美术馆/画廊职工双年展：八位艺术家，从“自我”走向“共性”。
about:
Presented as the 2nd Shanghai Museum/Gallery Staff Biennale, this group show guides visitors from “selfhood” to “commonality.” What seems most personal often reveals traits we recognize and share.

Through painting, performance video, installation and text, eight artists face the question every story of the self must answer: who is telling it?
about_zh:
作为第二届上海美术馆/画廊职工双年展，本次群展带领观众从“自我”走向“共性”：看似最个人的部分，往往藏着彼此可辨认、可共享的特质。

八位艺术家以绘画、行为影像、装置与文本创作，回应每一个关于自我的叙述都必须面对的问题：是谁在讲述？

title: Isolated Resonance
summary: Sound as something felt rather than heard: light, gesture and layered images from an artist who senses the world in her own way.
summary_zh: 声音不只被听见，也可以被感受：一位以独特方式感知世界的艺术家，用光、手势与影像构建的空间。
about:
In Xiaohan Luo’s work, sound is not simply heard but lingers in the body and memory. Flickering light, delicate movement and layered images open a space between hearing and not hearing.

Shaped by her own way of sensing sound, her installations and moving images invite audiences to slow down, perceive the world differently and treat silence as a place of possibility.
about_zh:
在 Xiaohan Luo 的作品中，声音不只是听觉体验，而是留存在身体与记忆里的感受。闪烁的光、细微的动作与层叠的影像，打开了一个介于听见与听不见之间的空间。

源于她独特的感知方式，这些装置与影像邀请观众放慢脚步，换一种方式感受世界，把寂静视为充满可能的地方。

title: Star Dream Voyager
subtitle: Future Adornments
summary: Retro-futuristic accessories from jewelry brand Jelly Muscle, set against a cosmic backdrop and full of playful energy.
summary_zh: 首饰品牌“果冻力”以宇宙为背景，呈现一系列高饱和、复古未来感的概念配饰。
about:
Jelly Muscle’s stories often begin with childhood memories: first impressions of color and form, found in playful plastic toys. Nature, the cosmos and everyday life feed its imaginative work.

“Star Dream Voyager: Future Adornments” takes the universe as its backdrop for a series of high-saturation, retro-futuristic conceptual accessories. The brand was founded in 2024 by London-trained designers Jojo and Linbing.
about_zh:
果冻力的故事常常始于童年记忆：最初对色彩与形态的印象，来自那些造型各异、色彩鲜艳的塑料玩具。自然、宇宙与日常生活，都是它天马行空创作的灵感。

《星梦旅者：未来饰界》以宇宙为创作背景，呈现一系列高饱和度、复古未来风格的概念配饰。品牌由设计师 Jojo 与 Linbing 于 2024 年创立。

title: Soft Monuments
summary: Cloth and soft textures made to stand as sculpture, proposing softness as structure and craft as an act of care.
summary_zh: 让布料与柔软的材质站立成雕塑，把柔软视为结构，把手工视为关怀。
about:
“Soft Monuments” turns cloth and pliable textures into standing sculptural forms. Through tension, internal structure and layering, soft materials occupy space vertically while keeping their vulnerability.

Treating fabric with the seriousness once reserved for stone and bronze, the works ask who is allowed to endure, and propose softness as structure and craft as an act of care.
about_zh:
《柔软的纪念碑》将布料与柔软的材质转化为站立的雕塑。借助张力、内部结构与层叠，柔软的材料竖立于空间之中，同时保留着自身的脆弱。

作品以对待石头与青铜般的郑重对待织物，追问谁被允许留存，并提出：柔软亦是结构，手工是一种关怀。

title: Rituals of Escape
subtitle: Where Repetition Becomes Resistance
subtitle_zh: Rituals of Escape: Where Repetition Becomes Resistance
summary: A solo show by Jing Zhou, where patient geometry and repetition turn into rhythm, presence and quiet resistance.
summary_zh: 周婧个展：耐心的几何与重复，化作节奏、在场与安静的抵抗。
about:
Jing Zhou’s works grow from quiet observations of boundaries, where geometry and rhythm emerge through patient repetition. What looks minimal holds emotional density; what seems routine is a way of reclaiming rhythm and presence.

Drawing on the symmetry of mandalas and her background in design, Zhou balances clarity with texture and restraint with release, turning repetition into resonance and stillness into feeling.
about_zh:
周婧的作品源于对边界的静默观察，几何与节奏在耐心的重复中浮现。看似极简，却蕴含情感的密度；看似日常，实则是对节奏与在场的重新夺回。

她从曼陀罗的对称结构与自身的设计背景出发，在清晰与肌理、克制与释放之间取得平衡，让重复化为共鸣，让静止化为感受。

title: Counterbalance
summary: Costume designer Lingyi Gao blends cultural imagery and unexpected fabrics to capture moments on the verge of balance.
summary_zh: 服装设计师 Lingyi Gao 融合不同文化意象与出人意料的面料，捕捉即将达到平衡的瞬间。
about:
Lingyi Gao’s creative process moves between the two ends of a scale, using unexpected fabrics and materials to capture moments on the verge of balance. She blends imagery from different cultures into a surprising yet harmonious fusion, like tropical rain falling over the Sahara.

A Beijing-based costume designer and film and TV styling director, she brings romanticism and intricate detail to every character she dresses.
about_zh:
Lingyi Gao 的创作像是在天平两端之间往返，以出人意料的面料与材料，捕捉即将达到平衡的瞬间。她善于融合不同文化背景的意象，创造意外却和谐的碰撞，宛如热带的雨落在撒哈拉。

她是常驻北京的服装设计师与影视造型指导，为每一个角色注入浪漫与精致的美学。

title: Natural and So: Land Design
subtitle: An Exhibition of Two Residence Design Works
subtitle_zh: 两间寓所的设计作品展
summary: Two homes by designer Wenqing Zhou, where design grows from care and a pure, natural language serves everyday life.
summary_zh: 设计师 Wenqing Zhou 的两间寓所设计作品展：以关怀为出发点，用纯粹自然的语言服务日常生活。
about:
“Design is fundamentally about service.” Whether caring for parents, raising children, cooking or doing chores, good design for daily life comes from love at its core.

The exhibition presents two residences shaped by this belief: a pure, natural language that aligns inner nature with the world, which the designer calls “Land Design.” He founded the residential design practice DAFU in 2008.
about_zh:
“设计的本质是服务。”无论照顾父母、养育孩子，还是烹饪与家务，好的生活设计都源于爱。

展览呈现两间寓所的设计作品，以纯粹自然的语言让内在本性与世界相融，设计师称之为“Land Design”。他于 2008 年创立住宅设计品牌 DAFU。
